strings.Het temperatuurverschil over de platenwi: The temperature difference across the plate heat exchanger (Tuo-Tui) stayed above the limit for 60 seconds (15 °C for heating and DHW, 8 °C for cooling). Control has stopped. Check the flow (pump, filter, air, valves), then reset the error.
strings.De flowschakelaar meldde geen flow terwi: The flow switch reported no flow while the compressor was running, for longer than the set delay. Control has stopped. Check pump P0, filter, air and the flow switch, then reset the error.

strings.P13 - Storing compressor - laag drukvers: P13 - Compressor fault - low pressure difference

strings.F22 - Storing sensor cv-aanvoertemperatu: F22 - Supply temperature sensor zone 2 fault
strings.De eerste keer wordt de normale werking: The first time, normal heat pump operation resumes automatically after 5 minutes.
The first time, normal heat pump operation resumes automatically after 5 minutes. If the same fault occurs three times within a certain period, the heat pump is blocked and must be restarted.
strings.De warmtepomp is geblokkeerd door een st: The heat pump is blocked by a compressor start fault.
strings.Als de persdruk meer dan 32 bar bedraagt: The compressor is switched off when the discharge pressure exceeds 32 bar.
strings.De compressorfrequentie zal worden begre: The compressor frequency is limited. The pressure drops and normal operation continues.
strings.De compressor wordt voorverwarmd om te k: The compressor is being preheated so it can start. It takes up to 30 minutes for the compressor to reach operating temperature. After that this warning clears by itself and the compressor starts.
Supply voltage too high or too low.
strings.De buitenunit laat de compressor niet dr: The outdoor unit does not run the compressor at this outside temperature (Ta). When heating this happens below about -25°C and above 46°C. The compressor starts again once Ta is within the operating range.
strings.Toerental compressor wordt verlaagd. Als: The compressor speed is reduced. If the same fault occurs three times within a certain period, the heat pump is blocked and must be restarted.
strings.Communicatiestoring tussen printplaten e: Communication fault between circuit boards and/or control panel.
strings.Er is een communicatiestoring tussen bei: There is a communication fault between the two circuit boards in the heat pump.
The supply voltage is not OK.
There is a problem with the inverter PCB.
strings.De voedingsspanning in de VDC-module (24: The supply voltage in the VDC module (24 volt converter) is too high or too low.
strings.De pomp startte niet binnen de verwachte: The pump did not start within the expected time. Check pump control, relays, operating state and the flow (flow switch), because this timeout is based on flow detection.
strings.De compressor startte niet binnen de ver: The compressor did not start within the expected time. Check permissions, protections and start conditions.
strings.De pomp stopte niet binnen de verwachte: The pump did not stop within the expected time. Check relay status, control logic and the flow (flow switch), because this timeout is based on flow detection.
strings.De 3-weg klep bevindt zich niet in de ve: The 3-way valve is not in the expected position (relay feedback missing or temperature deviation exceeded). Check valve control, wiring and valve motor.
strings.De Modbus-communicatie met de binnen- of: Modbus communication with the indoor or outdoor unit could not be restored within the expected time. Check cabling, power and Modbus settings.
strings.De binnenunit bevindt zich in failsafe o: The indoor unit is in failsafe or has restarted. One or more output registers (1099-1113) differ from the expected state. Control has stopped.
strings.De buitenunit stopte de compressor zelf: The outdoor unit stopped the compressor itself while OpenAmber was running it. Control has stopped. Check protections, power and the Modbus connection to the outdoor unit, then reset the error.
strings.De gekozen BLE-ruimtesensor heeft 10 min: The selected BLE room sensor has not sent a reading for 10 minutes. Check the battery and the range of the sensor.
Indoor unit EEPROM or status error.
strings.Wil je OpenAmber nu herstarten?: Do you want to restart OpenAmber now?
strings.De warmtepomp wordt gecontroleerd uit be: The heat pump is taken out of operation in a controlled way. Control resumes automatically after 30 minutes.
strings.Wil je de firmware update nu starten?: Do you want to start the firmware update now?
strings.De update kan veilig tijdens bedrijf. Of: The update is safe during operation. Or stop in a controlled way first and start the update again once the state is Standby.
